releaseNotes: v1.38.0 — Bible Reading Plans: choose a guided journey through Scripture (Whole Bible, Old Testament, New Testament, Gospels, or any single book) and Beslet will assign a daily reading that appears in Today's Flow. One tap opens the chapter in the existing Bible reader. Audio, AI Study, highlights, notes, and cross-references all work as before. English audio now uses the public-domain World English Bible (WEB) recording from eBible.org, matching the app's English text verse for verse. Amharic chapters keep the WordProject recording. Requires a connection to download chapter audio once, then cached offline. Also fixes a stale-player bug where tapping play after switching chapters could act on the previous chapter instead of the one you're reading.
